# IconButton

Bouton sans libellé visible : flèches du carrousel et bouton de lecture vidéo.

`AlterPark.IconButton` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<AlterPark.IconButton label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AlterPark.IconButton" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (IconButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'plain' \| 'play'` | plain : flèche orange 27 px (carrousel) · play : disque orange 89 px |
| `icon` | `'arrowLeft' \| 'arrowRight' \| React.ReactNode \| string` | 'arrowLeft' \| 'arrowRight' ou un nœud SVG ; pour play, l'URL d'une image |
| `label` * | `string` | Nom accessible, obligatoire. |
| `state` | `'hover' \| 'focus' \| 'active'` |  |

_Also accepts: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>._
